s.note: Toasted marshmallows dipped in dark chocolate, squashed between digestive biscuits
s.how: Toast 16 big marshmallows on sticks over the fire or a gas flame until blistered. Dip in 100g melted dark chocolate and squash between 2 digestive biscuits, 32 biscuits in all. Eat while still gooey.

s.note: Buttered white bread with mustard, ham, cheddar and pickles, wrapped to go
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with mustard. Fill with 200g ham, 100g sliced cheddar and a few pickles. Cut in half and wrap each tightly in wax paper, ready for the walk.

m.note: Thick beef patties on white bread with soft fried onions and tomato sauce
m.how: Season 800g beef mince with salt and pepper and shape into 4 thick patties. Cook over hot coals or in a smoking pan for 5 minutes a side. Fry 2 sliced onions alongside until soft and sweet. Serve the patties between thick slices of white bread with the onions and tomato sauce.

w.note: Lattice topped blueberry pie, cooled before slicing
w.how: Toss 750g blueberries with 150g sugar, the juice of a lemon and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool 3 hours.

d.note: Sarsaparilla poured over vanilla ice cream
d.how: Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each glass. Pour 300ml cold sarsaparilla slowly down the side of each glass, letting the foam settle before topping up. Serve straight away with a straw and a long spoon.
